summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of YOGI INTERNET portal. Backend: 30/30 pytest passed covering auth, admin guard, public routes, application CRUD (create/read/update/patch/delete + persistence via GET), categories, documents, settings, stats. Frontend: home loads with branding, category chips (10 including seeded 9 + All), dynamic search (scholarship keyword, Aadhaar document keyword, no-match state), category filter, application detail modal with documents list, trending section, footer. Admin: /admin unauthenticated redirect to /admin/login, invalid creds show error, valid login navigates to dashboard, dashboard stats visible (Total/Trending/Published), Applications tab lists apps, Add Application form creates row, Delete with confirm dialog removes row (toast 'Application deleted' shown), Documents/Categories/Contact tabs render and settings save button present.

issues: Radix Dialog console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for DialogContent. Add DialogDescription for accessibility.

action_items: (Optional a11y) Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to ApplicationModal DialogContent to silence Radix warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py hardcodes admin default password 'admin123' fallback in seed_admin — acceptable since ADMIN_PASSWORD env is set, but consider failing fast if missing.
verify_password not wrapped in try/except; a malformed stored hash would 500 the login. Low risk since seed controls it.
AdminDashboard.jsx is likely large; consider splitting into per-tab components if it exceeds 700 lines (not verified).
PATCH allowed fields exclude 'order' updates via move-up/move-down? Actually 'order' is allowed. Good.
public GET /api/applications/{id} returns 404 when unpublished — consistent behavior. Good.
